'''Fezzter''' was a fat, bald [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as [[Crying Dawn Singer]]'s road agent and manager, and was known to wear a metallic [[Color/Legends|gold]] skin-tight bodysuit. Fezzter was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] agents from the [[Interrogation (Imperial Security Bureau)/Legends|Interrogation]] branch after the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Yearo Seville]] [[Operation 45RA|kidnapped]] Crying Dawn Singer.
